create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent_id_from_db index to load from the solvent database
create_solvent_with_density: create a Solvent object with a custom solvent_density override instead of the database default
get_molecules_per_volume: get the molecules_per_volume property to convert solvent density to molecules per angstrom cubed
get_solvent_molar_mass: get the molar_mass attribute which is the sum of atomic masses for the solvent molecule
